entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Stalking Step

*It folds into the broken light, leaving only a leaf moving where it stood.*

Move up to 2 squares without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving, ending in a square with cover or concealment from that enemy. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally from other enemies. Does not grant Hidden; a separate Hide action still needs concealment and a roll when uncertain.

entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Turn the Blade

*A small turn of the wrist catches the blow on a waiting edge and sends it sliding past.*

Before one adjacent enemy makes a melee attack against this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll. Requires a held melee weapon. Against an NPC attack, grant 1 Boon to the single defense roll instead. Applies to this attack only; it does not grant a counterattack.

details.flavorMarkdown: *An accomplished swordsman in light dueling clothes and a distinctive mask, carrying a finely balanced ordinary blade. Reputation, precision and control of distance define the threat.*

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** A challenge is delivered with a precise account of an old insult.

**Purpose:** Win publicly and leave a reputation intact.

**Tactics and retreat:** Drive one opponent away from support; retreat rather than accept an ugly crowd fight.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Refuse the chosen ground or expose the sponsor behind the mask.

**Habitat:** City; court · **Communication:** Common and court language

**Loot:** Fine but ordinary melee weapon and 40 coins.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-masked-duelist


**Category:** Mortal · **Role:** Elite striker · **CV:** 27

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Turning blade | Agility | 1 Boon | 4 physical damage. | 6 physical damage. Push 1. | 8 physical damage. Push 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 4/6/8

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.4

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.25 → 1.4: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.988, O=5.596. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [Stalking Step](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/stalking-step.md), [Turn the Blade](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/turn-the-blade.md).

# Driving Blow

*The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-driving-blow


**Action:** Main Action

Use the printed attack. Standard pushes the target 1 square; Strong pushes it 2. Apply Stability before moving. This is a rider, not a separate attack or Force action.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
